urdu.name: میسرہ
urdu.long_meaning: Maysarah (میسرہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم آسانی، سہولت، آسودگی ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

faq.a: Maysarah is associated with the Arabic form ميسرة, whose core sense is ease, facility, convenience.

faq.q: What is the origin of Maysarah?
faq.a: Maysarah is associated with Arabic. Maysarah is Arabic مَيْسَرَة (Maysara) 'ease, facility, convenience', from the root ي س ر (y-s-r). The source gloss 'Abundance of joy' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as maysara.
Yes — the underlying form ميسرة is Arabic.
Maysarah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Maysarah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Maysarah is rendered میسرہ and carries the sense آسانی، سہولت، آسودگی.

faq.q: What does Maysarah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Maysarah is rendered میسره and carries the sense آسانی، سهولت، راحتی.
A romanized syllable approximation is may-sa-rah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Maysarah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Maysarah, maysarah. Script forms are ميسرة, میسره, میسرہ, मैसरा.

faq.q: Is Maysarah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
